request.style: English, quiet country ballad, soft female vocal, acoustic guitar, dobro, piano, light strings, simple and moving, 74 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The rich men came in their fine clothes
Their purses heavy, their noses high
They dropped their silver in the treasury
And made sure everyone saw it fly

[Verse]
Then came a widow, thin and gray
Two copper coins in her worn hand
She dropped them in without a sound
And no one there would understand

[Chorus]
This poor widow has put in more than all the others
For they all gave out of their abundance
But she, out of her poverty, put in everything she owned
All she had to live on

[Verse]
Jesus sat down across the way
And watched the people as they gave
He saw the coins that no one heard
He saw the faith that makes us brave

[Chorus]
This poor widow has put in more than all the others
For they all gave out of their abundance
But she, out of her poverty, put in everything she owned
All she had to live on

[Outro]
Two small coins
All she had to live on
